title: Site writes work through the tunnel; one reconnect banner, shown after 8 s

owner_note.text: The refused writes were the gateway's own address (it reaches the dev server over the PC's LAN address); a site tier now lets only append and the heartbeat ping through, never exec or /mcp. The slim top strip and the sheet's banner are now ONE banner at the top (dev/Socket/Link.js), shown only after a wire is down 8 s; the 17:44 and 17:45 restarts were mine (a hot-swap from my merge, then one restart_server).
